newsitem.title: USA: U.S. warns Americans to be careful in Albania.
newsitem.headline: U.S. warns Americans to be careful in Albania.

text.p: The United States Embassy in Tirana on Friday urged Americans to use caution in Albania and to stay away from crowds after a wave of protests by people afraid of losing their savings in collapsing pyramid schemes.

"There have been reports of violence throughout the country due to citizens' frustration with the problems of pyramid investment schemes," the embassy said in a statement to U.S. citizens in the eastern European country.
"We recommend that American citizens stay away from crowds and exercise caution at all times," it said. The statement was also released by the State Department in Washington.
About 5,000 Albanians hurled stones at a town hall in the southern town of Lushnje on Friday but police quickly dispersed the crowd.

The Lushnje protest was the latest bout of popular unrest in two weeks of demonstrations against crumbling pyramid schemes in which thousands of Albanians across the country have poured their life savings.
